Third-party notices for DWorkBench

Frontend: React, React DOM, Microsoft SignalR, TanStack Virtual, Lucide, RE2JS and their dependencies.
Backend: ASP.NET Core/.NET, Entity Framework Core, SSH.NET/BouncyCastle, Npgsql and SQLitePCLRaw.

The published package includes upstream npm license/notice files and NuGet nuspec metadata containing
package identities, versions, copyright and license expressions, together with upstream license text.
The frontend notice collection is intentionally inclusive of installed development package notices.
SQLite itself is in the public domain; the SQLitePCLRaw wrapper uses the Apache-2.0 license.

Official projects:

https://github.com/dotnet/runtime
https://github.com/dotnet/efcore
https://github.com/sshnet/SSH.NET
https://github.com/bcgit/bc-csharp
https://github.com/npgsql/npgsql
https://github.com/ericsink/SQLitePCL.raw
https://github.com/facebook/react
https://github.com/TanStack/virtual
